diagnostic_evidence.quote: \sum_{\alpha=1}^{N_x} P_{\alpha j}^{X} g_{\alpha \beta}^{n+1} (\rho_\alpha^{n+1})^2 = g_{j \beta}^{n+1} (\rho_j^{n+1})^2 \quad \text{ and } \quad \sum_{\beta=1}^{N_v} P_{k\beta}^{V} g_{j\beta}^{n+1} \omega_\beta e^{v_\beta^2/2} = g_{jk}^{n+1} \omega_k e^{v_k^2/2}

Analogously to the proof of Theorem \ref{theorem:stabilityMg} and, as the truncation step is designed not to alter these expressions, we can conclude that the proposed DLRA scheme is numerically stable under the time step restriction $\max_k(|v_k|) \Delta t \leq \Delta x$.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof of Theorem 4 contains multiple fatal gaps and invalid steps. First, it asserts that the basis augmentations in (19c) and (19e) ensure that the projectors satisfy P^X ((\rho^{n+1})^2 g^{n+1}) = (\rho^{n+1})^2 g^{n+1} and P^V (g^{n+1} \omega e^{v^2/2}) = g^{n+1} \omega e^{v^2/2}. However, g^{n+1} is computed in the S-step using the full rank-4r augmented basis \doublehat{X}^{n+1}, which already contains (\rho^{n+1})^2 \widehat{X}^{n+1}. Therefore, (\rho^{n+1})^2 g^{n+1} has components along (\rho^{n+1})^4 \widehat{X}^{n+1}, which are not in range(\doublehat{X}^{n+1}) in general. An identical failure occurs for the velocity projection. Second, in the algebraic step leading to this assertion, the sum over \alpha and \beta is erroneously factored as if g_{\alpha\beta}^{n+1} were separable, leaving \beta unsummed in one factor and summed in the other. Third, the proof completely ignores the rank truncation step of Algorithm (19), dismissing it with the unsupported assertion that 'the truncation step is designed not to alter these expressions'. Truncation drops singular values of H_2 and modifies g^{n+1}, and while the tailored truncation preserves the zeroth velocity moment condition \sum_k f_{jk}^{n+1} \omega_k e^{v_k^2} = \rho_j^{n+1}, it does not preserve the \mathscr{H}-norm bound.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must establish an invariant subspace under the nonlinear weight multiplication or develop an energy estimate that bounds the projection and truncation residuals in the \mathscr{H}-norm.
issues.overall_effect: The primary theoretical guarantee of the paper for the DLRA method—namely, the analytical proof of numerical stability and the hyperbolic CFL condition for the rank-adaptive dynamical low-rank scheme—is unestablished.
issues.title: Invalid stability proof and unestablished stability of the rank-adaptive DLRA scheme
issues.why_classification: Theorem 4 is a central advertised mathematical contribution of the paper. Repairing it cannot be done locally and requires a fundamentally new proof architecture or substantial modifications to the DLRA algorithm, with no complete repair supported by the source text.
